If your goal is to move to the next level of performance and health,
the science-based, up-to-date information in this book can help you get
there. You'll find answers to your questions about the Paleo Diet, Keto Diet,
gluten-free foods, energy drinks, commercial sports foods, muscle cramps,
organic foods, hyponatremia, amenorrhea, and recovery foods as well as
tips on how to apply this information to your busy lifestyle.

As you navigate your way through today’s confusing web of nutrition
advice, | invite you to enjoy this sixth edition as a resource that offers a
sustainable approach to finding success with food and weight. | use the
word sustainable because too many trendy diets are not easily sustainable
for the long term. They commonly end up creating “diet backlash,” includ-
